messages.subject: gdistsamp starting values
parts:
Hello all,

I've been trying to run gdistsamp function using bird point counts data. I have 147 sites, each site was visited twice (numPrimary = 2). I think I have the data in the right format, because I can put everything in an unmarkedFrame with no errors. I chose the gdistsamp function because I want to account for detection by distance but also account for other factors that affect detection, e.g. observer, wind. 
Any model I run (intercept only or with explanatory variables) resulted in the same error massage. 
I pasted an example for null models below (attached data files). Based on previous threads in this group, the error message is a problem is with starting values. In one of the threads it was suggested to run a Poisson mixture first and extract the starting values, but as you can see below that did not work. I also removed se = TRUE following a suggestion in previous thread, and that did not make a difference. I tried to run models for a number of species, all result in the same error message. 

My questions:
1. Is it possible that my data is not in the right format? (I attached a sample).
2. I am not sure how to choose starting values. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated. 

Thank you
Hila
